points.description: Names one valid defluoridation technique (e.g. Nalgonda process / precipitation with alum and lime, adsorption on activated alumina or bone char, or anion exchange resin).

Names a second, different valid defluoridation technique from the same set (precipitation with alum and lime/Nalgonda, adsorption on activated alumina/bone char, or metal-powered anion exchange resin).

rubric.notes: Award 1 mark for each correct, different technique, in any wording; technical names are not required (e.g. "alum and lime dosing" or "adsorption using alumina" is fine). Nalgonda and alum-lime precipitation count as the same technique, so do not credit both separately. Wrong extra items do not cost marks; 0 if none is correct.
